summary.text: Ryan McCabe is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives for District 96 in Lexington County.
His official page lists him as an attorney serving on the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Donald Ryan McCabe Jr. was born on April 9, 1973, in Columbia.
His official page lists a B.A. from Newberry College in 1995 and a J.D. from Campbell University School of Law in 1999.
